title: Prove normalized rewrites by propagation over let-named structures
summary: The propositional lemma of a normalized linear rewrite is now proved by the gate-propagation prover, whose terms name every and/or structure once by a let and do case analysis on a true disjunction before splitting atoms. This gives the clock synchronization QF_LRA benchmark, the last untriaged corpus failure, a complete Lean certificate where grind had failed.
